proof_adaptations: The positive mass and normal-square moment remain distinct; no R4 weakening is used for the mass. Under δsqrtL≤σ their unabsorbed bounds imply the printed estimates with another factor2.
The normal cone sector is represented by the independently reviewed inscribed two-normal rectangle, with universal constants and no inverse gap.
Half of the complete ordered nonparallel pair sum is the native leading term. Diagonal and parallel terms vanish pointwise, with no minimum-gap hypothesis or whole-family independence.
The actual base law may be singular; only volume-AE threshold regularity is used, transported by invertible affine threshold maps and product AE commutation.
Native L1 follows from actual measurable nonnegative moment sums and their integrable common Gaussian tube majorants. It is not inferred from a bound on an undefined total integral.
